# OpenBangla riti data

Unmodified copies of data files from [OpenBangla/riti](https://github.com/OpenBangla/riti)
at commit `afee54a79e230165d38f6b17161cd8ff971e1c49`, licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

| File | Used for |
|---|---|
| `dictionary.json` | Build-time input to `scripts/gen_bn_phonetic.py`: its words join `bn_phonetic.txt` as suggest-only candidates. |
| `suffix.json` | Shipped as `suggestions/src/main/assets/dictionaries/avro_suffix.json` for suffix joining. |
| `autocorrect.json` | Shipped as `suggestions/src/main/assets/dictionaries/avro_autocorrect.json`. |

Files derived from these (`bn_phonetic.txt`) are covered by the MPL-2.0 as well.
